summary: EShallgo Inc filed a Form 6-K attaching proxy statements for class A and class B ordinary shareholder meetings and an extraordinary general meeting to vote on increasing class B shares' voting rights from 50 to 400 votes per share. The board recommends a 'FOR' vote. This is a routine governance proposal to enhance insider control, not a special-situation catalyst. The filing contains no M&A, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other classic special-situation event. Given the absence of a forced/abrupt management departure or transformative corporate action, categorize as None.
